page.layout: One printed page, title page. Top: title block in large capitals, centred, partly faint and partly show-through. Middle: a small block of italic text in about six lines, centred. Below it: an engraved or woodcut device, centred, with no text. Bottom: place and printer lines in spaced capitals, centred. No text in the margins.

main_text.l: Deinde in Epitomen redacta, & notorum [illegible, ~8 letters]

page.notes: The scan is very faint. Much of the title block is show-through from the reverse, which is mirrored and must not be transcribed; the lines marked [illegible] are mostly the mirrored or unreadable parts. The readings "ferò", "iam vero po[?]", "per Iohan[?]" and the date are doubtful. The small italic block (about six lines) and the engraving are not legible enough to transcribe. The library stamp "Staatl. Bibliothek Regensburg" in red at the foot is excluded. Lines reading "BIBLIOTHECA" and "INSTITVTA" may belong to a larger title that is cut off by the scan.
